name: Mystic Manor
description: Widely regarded as the finest dark ride ever created by Walt Disney Imagineering — Mystic Manor is a masterpiece of trackless dark ride technology set in the eccentric manor of Lord Henry Mystic and his mischievous monkey Albert. Guests explore rooms filled with magical artefacts brought to life by Albert in a ride experience of extraordinary imagination, technical brilliance and visual splendour that surpasses every other Disney dark ride on earth. Suitable for all ages.

name: Iron Man Experience
description: The world first Marvel attraction at any Disney park — Iron Man Experience puts guests inside an Iron Man suit for a breathtaking flight over Hong Kong in a state-of-the-art motion simulator with stunning visual effects. A landmark attraction in Disney history and one of the most immersive superhero experiences in the world. Min 102cm.

name: Big Grizzly Mountain Runaway Mine Cars
description: A unique and exceptionally designed family coaster exclusive to Hong Kong Disneyland — Big Grizzly Mountain features forward and backward launches, a sudden drop-away floor and spectacular American wilderness theming that makes it one of the most original and rerideable family coasters at any Disney park in the world. Min 102cm.

name: Hyperspace Mountain
description: Classic Space Mountain reimagined as an X-Wing vs TIE Fighter Star Wars battle — indoor coaster through complete darkness with immersive Star Wars audio and visual effects. One of the most popular thrill rides at Hong Kong Disneyland. Min 102cm.

name: RC Racer
description: A massive half-pipe coaster themed to RC from Toy Story — RC Racer sends riders soaring back and forth on a giant half-pipe structure reaching 27 metres at the apex delivering breathtaking views and genuine thrills. One of the most visually striking attractions at Hong Kong Disneyland. Min 122cm.

name: It's a Small World
description: The beloved classic boat journey past hundreds of singing dolls representing children from every nation celebrating world unity — the Hong Kong version features unique Asian scenes not found at any other Disney park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Cinderella Carousel
description: A beautifully decorated classic carousel in Fantasyland featuring hand-painted horses and Disney character details — one of the most charming and photographed attractions at Hong Kong Disneyland. Suitable for all ages.

name: Orbitron
description: A classic spinning rocket ride in Tomorrowland where guests control the height of their own rocket ship as they orbit around a central tower — a beloved Disneyland classic and popular with families with younger children. Min 81cm.

name: Fantasy Gardens
description: A beautifully landscaped garden area in Fantasyland where Disney characters meet and greet guests — the most popular character meet and greet location at Hong Kong Disneyland and a must-visit for families with young children who want to meet Mickey, Minnie and Disney Princesses. Suitable for all ages.

name: Geyser Gulch
description: A spectacular outdoor water play area in Grizzly Gulch featuring interactive geysers, water cannons and splash zones — the most popular summer attraction for families with young children at Hong Kong Disneyland. Suitable for all ages.

name: Animation Academy
description: A charming interactive experience where Disney animators teach guests how to draw classic Disney characters step by step — one of the most unique and memorable family experiences at Hong Kong Disneyland and a wonderful creative activity for children of all ages. Suitable for all ages.

name: Disneyland Railroad
description: A charming steam-powered narrow gauge train that circles the entire Hong Kong Disneyland park — offering a relaxing scenic journey and a wonderful way to travel between the different lands while taking in the beautiful park landscapes. Suitable for all ages.
